verified_source.table_title: Detailed comparison of the results obtained by ILS with the results of Montoya et al. (2017) and Koc et al. (2018) for the E-VRP-NL (instances with 10, 20, or 40 customers)

column_meaning: Best objective among the methods compared in that table: Montoya et al. (2017) ILS+HC, Koc et al. (2018) LNS, and the ILS of Froger et al. (2022). It is the reference used for gaps in this repository. It is not a best-known set verified against later papers.
objective: Z_lit = travel + nonlinear charging. Customer service is excluded from this objective and included in the route-duration limit. The implementation subtracts total customer service from Z_full only after every customer is served once.

froger_2019.n20_rounding_note: tc1c20s4ct1 is 17.80 h in the 2022 Table 13 BKS column and 17.81 h in the 2019 Table 14 arc objective.

not_this_file.note: Wang, Adulyasak, Cordeau, and He report later E-VRP-NL solutions. Those values were not entered as gaps.
